meta.model: Gagge, Fobelets & Berglund 1986 two-node model via pythermalcomfort two_nodes_gagge

self_check.description: max |patched 59-step - official two_nodes_gagge(round_output=False)| over all cases and outputs

notes: Initial state is the model's neutral state: t_core 36.8, t_skin 33.7, m_bl 6.3, alfa 0.1, e_skin = 0.1*met, h_r 4.7.
wme = 0 in every case: pythermalcomfort subtracts wme (in met) from a W/m2 balance, which src/sim/gagge.ts does not reproduce.
mrt: thermofeel calculate_mean_radiant_temperature; dsrp = direct normal = fdir/cossza when cossza > 0.01.
